svg.title: Codemap's evidence stack
svg.desc: Four layers over the same source files of this repository, each reading more than the one below: ripgrep matches exact text, ast-grep matches syntax trees, Codebase Memory MCP links calls across files into a graph, and Codemap, on top, turns all three into summary and signals. A pink thread carries the most complex function through a hole in every layer to the first signals row.
svg.text: grep rewritten in Rust, and how coding agents read code by default
matches every line that contains a string, a call and a comment alike
parses each file into an abstract syntax tree, the structure under its text
matches structure, not text: calls, definitions, what sits inside what
indexes the whole repository into one persistent knowledge graph
resolves calls across files: callers, change impact, architecture, semantic search
chooses, orders, and names what an agent reads from all three
